Austin Landscape Lighting Service Areas

Outdoor lighting across Austin, TX

From quiet lakefront patios to busy neighborhood entries, we design low-voltage landscape lighting systems that feel tailored to the property, the neighborhood, and the way you use your outdoor spaces after dark.

Find Your Area Service Area FAQs
Greater Austin Coverage 20+ communities

Austin, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Georgetown, Lakeway, Dripping Springs, Buda, Kyle, Leander, Liberty Hill, Bee Cave, Pflugerville, Hutto, and more.

Coverage Finder

Choose your community to preview the right lighting approach.

Select a service area or search by city name. The details update instantly so visitors can see that the page is built for their part of Central Texas.

Austin

Primary service area

Austin

County
Travis County
Best-fit lighting
Estate lighting, architectural accents, pool and patio lighting
Common neighborhoods
Tarrytown, Westlake, Barton Hills, Circle C, Steiner Ranch
Request a Austin lighting consultation

Featured Communities

Built for the different ways Central Texas homes live after sunset.

A great lighting plan in Austin does not always look like a great lighting plan in Lakeway, Georgetown, or Dripping Springs. These cards keep the page locally relevant without needing a different design system.

Urban Austin

Austin neighborhoods

Architectural lighting, courtyard glow, pool lighting, security-conscious pathway lighting, and polished entry moments for homes close to the city core.

North Corridor

Round Rock, Cedar Park, Leander

Layered curb appeal, backyard entertaining zones, tree uplighting, and family-friendly walkways for fast-growing suburban properties.

Hill Country

Lakeway and Dripping Springs

Warm, restrained lighting for stone, oaks, terraces, gates, and long views where the goal is drama without glare.

North of Austin

Georgetown and Liberty Hill

Lighting for larger lots, heritage-style homes, ranch entries, extended driveways, and outdoor rooms designed for relaxed evenings.

Local Design Priorities

The same refined look, adjusted for your property and local conditions.

Central Texas properties deal with live oaks, limestone, pool decks, sloped lots, HOA rules, dark-sky expectations, heat, and sudden storms. The design should look beautiful, but it also needs to hold up.

01

Dark-sky-aware placement

Fixtures are aimed and shielded to create glow where it belongs, reduce glare, and keep the night feeling calm.

02

Weather-ready installation

Low-voltage wiring, transformers, and fixture placement are planned for Central Texas heat, irrigation, soil movement, and seasonal storms.

03

Neighborhood-sensitive design

Lighting levels can be tuned for Austin city lots, lake homes, suburban HOAs, larger acreage, and quiet Hill Country streets.

Service Area FAQs

Questions homeowners often ask before scheduling.

Do you serve neighborhoods outside Austin?

Yes. The core service area includes Austin plus nearby communities throughout Travis, Williamson, and Hays counties. If your city is not listed, request a consultation and include your address or neighborhood.

Can the lighting be adjusted for HOA or dark-sky requirements?

Yes. Fixture brightness, beam spread, shield placement, timers, and smart controls can all be planned around neighborhood requirements and a softer nighttime look.

Is the design different for Hill Country or lake homes?

Usually. Sloped lots, limestone, mature oaks, lake views, and longer drives often need more intentional fixture placement than a standard city lot.

Can I start with the front yard and expand later?

Yes. A phased lighting plan can begin with the entry, trees, and walkways, then expand later to patios, pools, gardens, drives, or outdoor kitchens.

Ready When You Are

Bring custom landscape lighting to your Central Texas property.

Tell us where you are, what you want to illuminate, and how you want the space to feel. We will help shape the right plan for your home and service area.

Request a Consultation Call +1 (281) 704-7210

content.rendered:
Bringing Austin Properties to Life After Dark

At Austin Landscape Lighting, we believe outdoor lighting should do more than brighten a property—it should transform it.

Every home, landscape, and commercial property has unique architectural details, mature trees, gardens, pathways, and outdoor living spaces that deserve to be appreciated long after the sun goes down. Our mission is to create custom landscape lighting systems that highlight those features while improving safety, security, and curb appeal.

As a locally focused Austin landscape lighting company, we specialize in designing, installing, maintaining, and upgrading premium outdoor lighting systems for residential and commercial properties throughout Austin and the surrounding communities.

Whether you’re looking to create a welcoming front entrance, illuminate a backyard entertainment area, showcase architectural details, or increase nighttime visibility, our experienced team delivers lighting solutions built specifically for your property.

Our Passion for Outdoor Lighting

Landscape lighting is both an art and a science.

It requires technical expertise, thoughtful design, and an understanding of how light interacts with architecture, trees, stonework, water features, and outdoor living spaces.

Rather than relying on generic layouts or one-size-fits-all installations, we create lighting designs that complement the natural beauty of your property.

Every project begins with listening.

We take the time to understand your goals, evaluate your landscape, identify focal points, and recommend lighting techniques that produce dramatic yet natural-looking results.

The goal is simple:

Create an outdoor environment that looks just as impressive at night as it does during the day.

Professional Landscape Lighting Services in Austin

Austin Landscape Lighting provides complete outdoor lighting solutions from concept to completion.

Our services include:

  • Custom landscape lighting design
  • Outdoor lighting installation
  • Architectural lighting
  • Pathway and walkway lighting
  • Garden lighting
  • Tree uplighting
  • Accent lighting
  • Patio lighting
  • Deck lighting
  • Pool area lighting
  • Outdoor entertainment lighting
  • LED landscape lighting upgrades
  • Smart lighting systems
  • Low-voltage lighting installation
  • Landscape lighting repair
  • Routine maintenance
  • System upgrades and expansions

Every installation is carefully planned to maximize beauty while minimizing energy consumption through efficient LED technology and high-quality fixtures.

Why Homeowners Choose Austin Landscape Lighting

Choosing a landscape lighting contractor isn’t simply about installing fixtures.

It’s about trusting someone with the appearance, safety, and long-term value of your property.

Our clients choose Austin Landscape Lighting because we focus on quality at every stage of the project.

Personalized Designs

No two homes are alike.

Every lighting system is custom designed to complement your home’s architecture, landscaping, and lifestyle.

Premium Materials

We use durable, professional-grade fixtures built to withstand Central Texas weather while delivering consistent performance for years.

Energy-Efficient LED Lighting

Modern LED technology allows homeowners to enjoy beautiful outdoor lighting while reducing energy consumption and maintenance costs.

Attention to Detail

Fixture placement, beam angles, color temperature, and lighting intensity all work together to create a balanced and sophisticated appearance.

Honest Communication

We believe in transparent recommendations, clear pricing, and keeping clients informed throughout every phase of the project.

Enhancing More Than Curb Appeal

Beautiful lighting certainly makes a home stand out.

However, the benefits extend much further.

Our professionally designed landscape lighting systems help homeowners:

  • Improve nighttime safety
  • Increase security around the property
  • Highlight architectural features
  • Showcase mature landscaping
  • Create inviting outdoor living spaces
  • Extend the use of patios and backyards
  • Improve property value
  • Enhance first impressions
  • Increase visibility along walkways and driveways
  • Enjoy outdoor entertaining after sunset

The result is an outdoor environment that’s functional, elegant, and welcoming every evening.

Proudly Serving Austin and Surrounding Communities

Austin Landscape Lighting proudly serves homeowners and businesses throughout Central Texas.

Our service areas include:

  • Austin
  • West Lake Hills
  • Lakeway
  • Bee Cave
  • Cedar Park
  • Round Rock
  • Georgetown
  • Pflugerville
  • Rollingwood
  • Dripping Springs
  • Leander
  • Surrounding Austin communities

No matter the size of your property, we bring the same commitment to craftsmanship, creativity, and customer service.

Our Design Process

We believe exceptional results begin with careful planning.

Our proven process includes:

Initial Consultation

We meet with you to discuss your goals, evaluate your property, and identify opportunities for dramatic lighting enhancements.

Custom Lighting Design

We develop a personalized lighting plan based on your landscape, architecture, outdoor living spaces, and desired ambiance.

Professional Installation

Our experienced installers carefully position every fixture to achieve optimal illumination while protecting your landscaping.

System Testing and Fine-Tuning

Before completing the project, we adjust fixture placement, beam angles, and brightness levels to ensure every element looks its best.

Ongoing Maintenance

Outdoor lighting systems require occasional adjustments and maintenance. We help keep your lighting performing beautifully year after year.

Committed to Quality

Quality isn’t just reflected in the fixtures we install.

It’s reflected in every interaction with our clients.

From your first consultation to the final nighttime walkthrough, our team is committed to delivering exceptional workmanship, dependable service, and lighting solutions that exceed expectations.

We take pride in creating outdoor environments that homeowners enjoy every evening while adding lasting beauty and value to their property.

Let’s Illuminate Your Property

Whether you’re building a new home, upgrading an existing landscape, or replacing an outdated lighting system, Austin Landscape Lighting is ready to help.

Our team combines thoughtful design, premium materials, and expert installation to create outdoor lighting systems that enhance the beauty, safety, and functionality of your property.

Contact Austin Landscape Lighting today to schedule your consultation and discover how professionally designed landscape lighting can completely transform your home after dark.

Austin Landscape Lighting (“Company,” “we,” “our,” or “us”) values your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, when we share it, and the choices you have regarding your information when you visit our website or use our services.

By using our website, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

Information We Collect

We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide, including:

  • Name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Property address
  • City and ZIP code
  • Project details
  • Any information you include in contact forms or emails

We also automatically collect certain technical information when you visit our website, including:

  • IP address
  • Browser type
  • Device information
  • Operating system
  • Pages visited
  • Time spent on our website
  • Referring website
  • General geographic location
  • Cookies and similar tracking technologies

How We Use Your Information

The information we collect helps us provide better services and improve your experience.

We may use your information to:

  • Respond to inquiries and estimate requests
  • Schedule consultations
  • Provide landscape lighting services
  • Communicate regarding ongoing projects
  • Send appointment reminders
  • Improve our website and customer experience
  • Analyze website traffic and performance
  • Prevent fraud or unauthorized activity
  • Comply with legal obligations
  • Send occasional marketing communications (only where permitted by law)

Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve functionality and understand how visitors interact with our website.

Cookies may help us:

  • Remember user preferences
  • Analyze website traffic
  • Improve website performance
  • Measure marketing effectiveness

Most web browsers allow you to disable cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling cookies may affect certain website functionality.

Third-Party Services

We may use trusted third-party providers to help operate our business and website.

These services may include:

  • Website analytics providers
  • Contact form services
  • Email communication platforms
  • Scheduling software
  • Customer relationship management (CRM) software
  • Payment processors (if applicable)
  • Website hosting providers

These third parties receive only the information necessary to perform their services and are expected to maintain appropriate security standards.

Google Analytics

Our website may use Google Analytics to better understand visitor behavior.

Google Analytics may collect information such as:

  • Pages viewed
  • Session duration
  • Device information
  • Browser information
  • Approximate geographic location

This information is used only to improve our website and services.

You may opt out of Google Analytics by using Google’s browser opt-out tools if desired.

Advertising and Remarketing

We may use advertising platforms, including Google Ads and Meta Ads, to display relevant advertisements to previous website visitors.

These platforms may use cookies or similar technologies to personalize advertising.

You can adjust your advertising preferences through your browser or advertising platform settings.

How We Protect Your Information

We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

While we strive to protect your information, no method of electronic transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Sharing Your Information

We do not sell your personal information.

We may share information only in limited situations, including:

  • With trusted service providers assisting our business
  • To comply with legal requirements
  • To protect our legal rights
  • During a business transfer, merger, or acquisition
  • With your consent

Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information.

These rights may include:

  • Request access to your personal information
  • Request correction of inaccurate information
  • Request deletion of your information
  • Request restrictions on processing
  • Object to certain data processing activities
  • Withdraw consent where applicable

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.

Email Communications

If you subscribe to updates or receive promotional emails from us, you may unsubscribe at any time by following the unsubscribe instructions included in the email or by contacting us directly.

Please note that service-related communications regarding active projects may still be sent.

Children’s Privacy

Our website and services are intended for adults.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13. If we become aware that personal information has been collected from a child without appropriate consent, we will promptly delete it.

External Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites.

We are not responsible for the privacy practices, policies, or content of websites operated by others. We encourage users to review the privacy policies of any external websites they visit.

Data Retention

We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to:

  • Provide requested services
  • Maintain business records
  • Comply with legal obligations
  • Resolve disputes
  • Enforce our agreements

When information is no longer needed, we take reasonable steps to securely delete or anonymize it.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our business practices, technology, or legal requirements.

Any updates will be posted on this page along with the revised Effective Date.

Your continued use of our website after changes become effective constitutes acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your personal information is handled, please contact Austin Landscape Lighting through the contact information provided on our website.

We are committed to addressing your privacy concerns promptly and professionally.
